# About Me!

I'm Connor, a data enthusiast who loves exploring datasets, building machine learning models and solving novel problems. I enjoy applying my skills to a variety of domains, from forecasting weather patterns to predicting how proteins interact, if there's data involved, there are always patterns to be discovered. I hold a Computer Science degree from VCU with minors in Math and Data Science.
